name: Rosemary Wells (O'Dell)
notable_stories: Arthur Wells' biological daughter (~same age as George Sr., so ~1916), who became George Sr.'s step-sister and his closest sibling-figure — raised essentially as his sister
notes: Not a blood relative of Adams line. Step-sister of George Francis Adams Sr. Daughter of Arthur Wells.

CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Mother is not Serena Marie Nevada Trumbo (confirmed by Brendan Adams): Rosemary was born about 1916 and Serena married Arthur Wells in 1929. Rosemary was Arthur's daughter from an earlier marriage, so she was a step-sister of George Francis Adams Sr. Her mother is not recorded.
